title: Location filter: rightmost, lists accessible locations, All locations on top
refs: SV-8603 (SBC spec v20 2026-08-17 Story 4 S4-R1; S4-R2; S4-R3 + single-location filter HIDDEN per Chris Ward answer 2026-07-31 Q1=A; applied suite-wide)
preconds: 1. You are on the Sales By Customer report as a user with access to two or more locations.
steps:
1. Look at the report toolbar's filters from left to right.
2. Open the location filter and read its options.
3. Click the "All locations" option, then click it again.
4. Then sign in as a user with access to only ONE location, open the report and look for the Location filter again.
expected:
1. The location filter is the rightmost filter in the toolbar.
2. It lists the locations the signed-in user has access to.
3. An "All locations" option is pinned to the top.
4. Activating "All locations" selects every listed location at once; activating it again clears them all at once.
5. For a user with access to only one location the Location filter is NOT shown at all — the report simply shows that one location's data.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and the Sales By Customer report specification version 20 (S4-R1, S4-R2, S4-R3), read on 17 August 2026. Chris Ward confirmed this on 8/5/2026 in his answers in this file: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1x8cuYJlFsDHalVZZTh156_ZCq2gcOaGY/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=106388879401921597782&rtpof=true&sd=true, read on 17 August 2026
Last checked against build v3.8-da72171 on 8/19/2026.
